name: Multiple Self-Healing Squamous Epithelioma

criteria.description: Presence of multiple squamous epithelioma lesions that spontaneously regress
Histopathological confirmation showing well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma features with spontaneous regression
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
Lack of metastatic spread despite multiple lesions

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of multiple self-healing squamous epithelioma lesions with histopathological confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not definitive; clinical course is characteristic.

laboratory: Histopathology showing well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma with signs of regression
imaging: Ultrasound of regional lymph nodes showing reactive lymphadenopathy without malignancy
genetic: Mutations in TGFBR1 gene associated with autosomal dominant inheritance
other: Clinical course characterized by spontaneous regression of lesions

distinguishingFeatures: Typically solitary lesion rather than multiple
Faster growth and spontaneous regression within weeks
Histopathology may overlap but clinical presentation differs
Often associated with immunosuppression or UV exposure

redFlags: Severe secondary infection or systemic symptoms
